scholarships.name: UTAS International Scholarship
scholarships.description: Merit-based tuition reduction for high-achieving international students commencing undergraduate or postgraduate coursework programs.
scholarships.descriptionRu: Стипендия на основе академических достижений для международных студентов бакалавриата и магистратуры University of Tasmania.

scholarships.name: Tasmania International Excellence Scholarship
scholarships.description: Competitive scholarship awarded to outstanding international applicants with exceptional academic records, covering partial tuition fees across all faculties.
scholarships.descriptionRu: Конкурсная стипендия для выдающихся международных абитуриентов с отличными академическими результатами — частичное покрытие стоимости обучения.

scholarships.name: Australia Awards Scholarship
scholarships.description: Australian Government scholarship covering full tuition, living allowance, travel, and health cover for students from eligible developing countries.

scholarships.description: Named after the former Tasmanian Premier, this scholarship supports students who demonstrate financial need and community contribution.

paragraphs: The University of Tasmania (UTAS) is Australia's fourth oldest university, founded in 1890 in Hobart, the capital of Tasmania. With over 29,000 enrolled students and a budget exceeding AU$770 million, UTAS is a leading research institution known worldwide for its strengths in marine and Antarctic science, environmental studies, and health sciences. The Institute for Marine and Antarctic Studies (IMAS) and the Australian Maritime College position UTAS as a global centre for ocean and maritime research.

UTAS operates across four campuses: the main Sandy Bay campus in Hobart, the Inveresk campus in Launceston hosting the Australian Maritime College, the Cradle Coast campus in Burnie, and a specialist Rozelle campus in Sydney for health programs. The university's five academic colleges — College of Arts, Law and Education; College of Health and Medicine; College of Sciences and Engineering; Tasmanian School of Business and Economics; and University College — offer more than 100 undergraduate and 150 postgraduate coursework programs.

International students are supported through a dedicated pathway program via University College, which offers English Language Programs, a University Foundation Program, and diplomas that articulate directly into UTAS degree programs. Entry requirements vary by program, with most undergraduate courses requiring an IELTS Academic score of 6.5 and postgraduate programs requiring 6.5–7.0. UTAS has strong links with universities across the Utrecht Network and partners with over 19 institutions globally.

Tasmania's unique natural environment makes UTAS a compelling destination for students interested in ecology, marine biology, climate science, and sustainability. With QS World Ranking #314 (2025), multiple 5-star ratings from the Australian Research Council, and alumni including Queen Mary of Denmark and Booker Prize winner Richard Flanagan, UTAS combines academic excellence with the tranquillity of island living in one of Australia's most liveable regions.
paragraphsRu: University of Tasmania (UTAS) — четвёртый по возрасту университет Австралии, основанный в 1890 году в Хобарте, столице Тасмании. Более 29 000 студентов и бюджет свыше AU$770 млн делают UTAS ведущим исследовательским учреждением с мировым признанием в области морских и антарктических наук, экологии и здравоохранения. Institute for Marine and Antarctic Studies (IMAS) и Australian Maritime College делают UTAS глобальным центром морских и океанических исследований.

UTAS работает на четырёх кампусах: главный Sandy Bay в Хобарте, кампус Inveresk в Лонсестоне (Australian Maritime College), Cradle Coast в Берни и Rozelle в Сиднее для программ здравоохранения. Пять академических колледжей — College of Arts, Law and Education; College of Health and Medicine; College of Sciences and Engineering; Tasmanian School of Business and Economics; University College — предлагают более 100 бакалаврских и 150 постградуальных программ.

Для международных студентов University College предлагает English Language Programs, University Foundation Program и дипломы прямого поступления в степенные программы UTAS. Большинство бакалаврских программ требуют IELTS Academic 6.5, постградуальные — 6.5–7.0. UTAS входит в сеть Utrecht Network и сотрудничает с более чем 19 вузами по всему миру.

Уникальная природная среда Тасмании делает UTAS привлекательным выбором для студентов в области экологии, морской биологии, климатологии и устойчивого развития. При QS World Ranking #314 (2025), множественных оценках «5 звёзд» от Australian Research Council и таких выпускниках, как королева Дании Мэри и лауреат Booker Prize Ричард Фланаган, UTAS сочетает академическое превосходство с комфортной жизнью на одном из самых живописных островов Австралии.
